# ghost/futoshiki

Futoshiki (F-Droid): start a 4x4 puzzle, place digits, read the grid. The inequality arrows are drawn only, so an agent reads them from a screenshot. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/futoshiki
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/futoshiki new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/futoshiki place --device <serial> --param row=<row> --param col=<col> --param digit=<digit>
ghost skill run ghost/futoshiki reset_puzzle --device <serial> --param confirm=<confirm>
ghost skill run ghost/futoshiki get_grid --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a Futoshiki puzzle
- `place`: Put 2 in row 1 column 2
- `reset_puzzle`: Reset the puzzle
- `get_grid`: What is on the Futoshiki board?
